text:
jamie: VanguardRetail POC kickoff. They want streaming chat + function/tool calls, strict JSON schema output, SAML SSO, and customer-managed HSM/KMS. POC hosted but they need BYOK and SOC2 docs. Also asked for a short demo path that tolerates token rotation in the browser.

lee: Quick q: will the storefront use direct browser SSE or a server proxy?

jamie: Direct browser SSE for product pages, backend workers for enrichment. They want ephemeral creds in the browser for safety.

ana: Heads-up from security: hosted+BYOK OK on enterprise plan but legal LOA + KMS attestation required. HSM request possible but extra ops. SOC2 report available under NDA.

lee: Tech notes: Our streaming returns event chunks; function calls are emitted as chunks with type="function_call" and args JSON. For strict schema, send JSON Schema in system prompt and validate assembled payload on finalization. We can also attach schema id to the request so server-side validation is enabled.

jamie: Are there any known issues with ephemeral creds + browser SSE?

lee: There is an edge when a token rotates mid-stream that can lead to repeated 401 reconnects if the client retries aggressively. Two options we recommend: 1) server-side token broker that issues short-lived session tokens to the browser and handles refresh + graceful reconnects; 2) resumable-stream pattern: open with a resumable_id returned by the server, on reconnect send resumable_id and offset so server can continue without replaying full context. We have an internal demo of resumable streams.

ana: Security preference: brokered tokens are simpler for compliance. If they insist on direct BYOK in hosted, we must list lead time and legal addenda. Also ask whether they need audit log exports to their SIEM.

lee: Small sample reconnect pseudocode (browser):
```js
// on 401: fetch /session/renew -> { token, resumable_id }
// then re-open EventSource with ?resumable_id=...
const es = new EventSource(`/v1/chat/stream?resumable_id=${id}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
```
Reconnect strategy avoids replaying entire history and minimizes demo flakiness.

jamie: Pricing ask: rough calc for bursty peaks ~1k QPS for 10-20m windows. Can we give a hosted estimate vs dedicated reserved?

lee: Quick ballpark: assume avg 80 prompt tokens + 120 response tokens = 200 tokens per request. At hosted rate X per 1k tokens -> multiply by QPS and duration. Dedicated adds a fixed reserved uplift but lowers per-token unit cost and gives latency SLOs. I can assemble a short spreadsheet.

ci-bot: Note: branch "resumable-streams" opened by @lee (PR #1411) - tests pending.

ana: I'll prefill the security questionnaire and flag BYOK/HSM items. Please send customer contact and timeline.

jamie: Contact is carol@vanguardretail.com. Demo tentatively next Tue. Tagging @lee @ana for followups. :thumbsup:
